description:
Prior-test registry query: what has actually been tested on an instrument/timeframe/strategy-type before, and what the prior evidence says. Every field is optional but at least one must be supplied.

VALUE: What has actually been tested on this instrument, timeframe and strategy type before, and what the prior evidence says — so you do not pay to rediscover a known result.

PRICE: $0.05 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.

family.description: The strategy family, e.g. 'breakout'. Case and separator insensitive.
family.title: Family

free_text.description: A free-text description, matched on normalised token overlap against the entry's name, type, family and edge_type. Generic words ('strategy', 'backtest', 'using') are stopwords and carry no matching signal.
free_text.title: Free Text

instrument.description: The instrument to look up, e.g. 'USD_JPY'. NORMALISED: USDJPY, USD/JPY, usd-jpy and USD_JPY are all one instrument. Aliases: XAUUSD/gold -> XAU_USD, XAGUSD/silver -> XAG_USD, SPX500 -> SPX500_USD, NAS100 -> NAS100_USD.
instrument.title: Instrument

strategy_type.description: The strategy type, e.g. 'donchian_breakout'. Case and separator insensitive: 'Donchian Breakout' == 'donchian_breakout'.
strategy_type.title: Strategy Type

timeframe.description: The timeframe to look up, e.g. 'H1'. NORMALISED: 60m == H1, 1h == H1, 4h == H4, 1d == D1.
timeframe.title: Timeframe
